name: Tajik National Park (Mountains of the Pamirs)
story: Tajik National Park is a national park and nature reserve in eastern Tajikistan that covers parts of the Pamir Mountains, the third-highest mountain system in the world. Established in 1992, it spans 26,116.74 square kilometres.
matters: The park provides a habitat for wild animals including the snow leopard and Marco Polo sheep. It also includes the Fedchenko Glacier and Karakul Lake.
